title: I will try, Stephen said, and let you know tomorrow. I know two editors slightly
html_source:
Stephen now has two plans and a choice to make. Mulligan has asked him to meet him at the Ship at half twelve and the anti-Semite Deasy has asked him to deliver the letter to the editor of The Homestead (George Russell).

This is a very good example of how little of Stephen’s self he reveals through his internal narrative . He goes to the National Library under the guise of Deasy’s errand but mainly to deliver his lecture on Hamlet which Mulligan mocked in Telemachus.
